output_text: Implemented a closed optional dependency_revision input on the existing published V3 route only. It binds exact predecessor/source/old edges, preserves all V3 contracts and non-edge V1 fields, validates both graphs and computes downstream closure across their union. The existing native compiler reuses frozen V1/V3 peers, derives the corrected frozen partition, requires fresh V4 rather than installing old V4 reuse, and rejects unrelated post-publication drift with the existing archive/repair handling. Role-only/projection-only routes and execution receipts remain unchanged. Changes limited to three declared production owners; frozen tests untouched.
